t: This is a millennium marker in Aldermanbury Square, commissioned by the Worshipful Company of Brewers and created by Richard Kindersley, a British typeface designer, stone letter carver and sculptor. It commemorates Monica of Hippo, an early North African Christian saint and the mother of Saint Augustine. She is remembered in the Catholic and Orthodox Churches, and Augustine wrote about her devotion and prayerful life in his Confessions.
